subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album support be automatic for existing `sendMessage`/`mediaUrls` payloads, exposed as a new explicit `send-media-group` action, or supported through both with a documented contract?
rationale: Current main already carries multiple media URLs through the normal send path, while the open draft introduces a parallel action and parameter name; choosing the contract affects tool prompting, docs, fallback behavior, and plugin API stability.

options.title: Group eligible existing mediaUrls
options.body: Port or replace the draft so existing `message.send` media arrays can become Telegram albums when eligible, with explicit fallbacks for non-groupable content.

options.title: Adopt a separate album action
options.body: Keep sequential `mediaUrls` behavior and add a new explicit album action or parameter, accepting the extra public API surface and docs work.

options.title: Defer album support
options.body: Leave current sequential delivery as the supported behavior and close or supersede the draft only after maintainers state that album grouping is out of scope.

recommendation.title: Group eligible existing mediaUrls
recommendation.body: Port or replace the draft so existing `message.send` media arrays can become Telegram albums when eligible, with explicit fallbacks for non-groupable content.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already handled prior cleanup review here and has recent Telegram action/docs history, making them the best available owner for the API-shape decision.
